overview: This one-page U.S. Department of State list of papers serves as a cross-reference for material concerning Japanese news-gathering activity in Uruguay. It records a request for an estimate of the number of Japanese newspaper correspondents there and identification of those whom the Uruguayan government wished to expel, directing the reader to decimal file 701.0433/78 rather than supplying the underlying correspondence.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Japanese newspaper correspondents in Uruguay
subfiles.about: The sheet cross-references a request for information about Japanese newspaper correspondents in Uruguay and those targeted for expulsion by the Uruguayan government.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing sheet identifies material concerning Japanese news-gathering agencies in Uruguay. It notes that an estimate of the total number of Japanese newspaper correspondents was requested, along with the names or number of those whom the Uruguayan government wished to expel. The underlying material is cross-referenced to decimal file 701.0433/78; the entry also appears to mention December 11, but no year is legible.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a provenance and cross-reference record: it links the press file to separate diplomatic correspondence in decimal file 701.0433/78. Although it contains no substantive report, it documents official concern with the size and composition of the Japanese press presence in Uruguay and the Uruguayan government's contemplated expulsions, offering a lead for research into wartime or immediate postwar controls on Japanese nationals and information networks.
